summary: All three specs import { expect, test } from the fixtures file, not from @playwright/test directly. No raw selectors appear in the spec — every locator is behind UpdateProfilePage. No hard waits. Every test has a specific assertion (toContainText, toHaveValue, toHaveText, toBeHidden) rather than just checking for the absence of an error. All test data comes from buildProfileUpdate(); no hard-coded names, addresses, or phone numbers.
